metadata.title: Vintage Polaroid Collage with Butterfly Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format nostalgic composition featuring a central vintage-style photograph with a white border, overlaid with a vibrant, high-contrast butterfly and raw, hand-painted typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: High-fidelity butterfly vs. low-fidelity vintage photograph
Hand-drawn black ink text vs. textured white polaroid frame
Warm skin tones vs. cool-toned shadows and vibrant red butterfly wings
coreInvariants: Polaroid-style white border with visible paper texture and wear
Film grain and slight motion blur on the central photograph
A single, large butterfly breaking the frame's boundary

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central photograph occupies 70% of the canvas; butterfly is positioned in the lower-left corner, overlapping the frame and image.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant red and black butterfly acts as the primary visual entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the butterfly in the bottom left, eyes move up to the faces in the photo, then down to the hand-drawn text at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The off-white textured border provides significant negative space, grounding the central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/Cream for the frame and highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the shadows and ink-like typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red and magenta within the butterfly wings.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The photograph uses desaturated, warm tones, while the butterfly uses high saturation to create a modern-vintage contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon colors except for the butterfly
Muted, sepia-adjacent tones for the photo

letterConstructionRules: Rough, uneven strokes mimicking a felt-tip marker or paint brush
Variable line weight with visible ink bleed
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters have jagged edges and slight distressing
Crossbars are placed at varying heights

composition.relationshipToImage: placed on the white border below the photo

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single hand-drawn style to maintain a raw, personal aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Subtle face tattoo/marking on the subject

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, DIY aesthetic of the original lettering.
Captures the uneven ink distribution and organic edges.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 90s-style photograph of a mother and baby, featuring film grain and warm lighting. Place this inside a textured, slightly worn white Polaroid frame. Add a high-detail, vibrant red and black butterfly in the bottom left corner, overlapping the frame edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a black marker-style brush, hand-draw the desired text in all-caps centered on the bottom white border of the frame. Ensure the strokes look organic and slightly uneven.

verificationChecks: Is the butterfly significantly more saturated than the photo?
Does the text look hand-drawn rather than typed?
Is the Polaroid frame texture visible and aged?

adjustableVariables: Level of film grain and photo aging
Thickness of the marker strokes in the text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Tactile paper texture on the border

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic film grain distribution.
Ensure the butterfly looks like a physical overlay.
Verify the text has 'ink bleed' characteristics.
Confirm the Polaroid border has subtle grime or wear.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Photo + Polaroid Frame + Vibrant Biological Overlay + Hand-drawn Marker Typography = Nostalgic Grunge Aesthetic
